name: Regex Tester API
description: Deterministic regular-expression tester & analyzer running on the ECMAScript (JavaScript) engine. /analyze statically inspects a pattern — compile validity, exact capture-group count and named-group names, anchors, feature flags (alternation/lookahead/lookbehind/backreference/quantifier/character-class) and a conservative catastrophic-backtracking (ReDoS) risk check — without ever executing it. /test compiles and runs the pattern against caller-supplied inputs, returning every match with positional and named capture groups, but refuses to execute patterns whose structure looks catastrophic. No LLM, nothing fetched, nothing stored.

endpointPricing.description: Statically analyze a regex (validity, groups, features, ReDoS risk) — no execution
Run a regex against inputs and return matches with capture & named groups
